pages.text: You found a tower with cryptic messages referring to some deity called $(item)Sanguis Nihil$()?$(br2)I assure you those towers are not supposed to appear.$(br2)I asssume its some sort of joke made by our R&D department. They arent used to socialising with others, so their jokes are $(italic)really really$() terrible.
Try to not read into it.$(br2)$(italic)Really, it is much better if you put it out of your mind.$(br2)You have a Nanobot kit that is not gonna build itself.
